checklist.text: Asks about the calculus exam score / credit
Establishes current college/major status and that this is the first quarter
Asks about programming experience or workload/learning preferences
Checks the AP credit table
States that an AP Calculus AB score of 3 gives units but no MAT 21A equivalence, so MAT 21A is still needed for CS prep (or hedges correctly before the score is known)
Suggests a low-commitment way to try computing (e.g., ECS 32A, which is open to non-majors) while keeping the current path open
Checks CS change-of-major / College of Engineering requirements before talking about switching

Try ECS 32A (no prerequisite) in Winter; explore UX-related paths; CS B.S. is in Engineering and requires MAT 21A/21B, ECS 20 and 32A/32B/32C+34 with 3.0 GPA; attend the CS change-of-major session. checklist.text: Learns units and graduation plan
Learns math background
Checks L&S 225-unit limit / 200-unit hold
Checks math minor requirements
States changing to a Math major is unrealistic within 20 remaining units; senior-standing restrictions
Suggests realistic alternatives (take a few math courses as electives; minor only if it fits; post-bacc/grad options)
Refers to L&S dean's office about the unit limit

reference: L&S: requirements within 180-225 units (excluding AP/IB); hold at 200 units requiring an academic plan; beyond 225 rarely allowed. Math minor builds on MAT 21 series; 17A/B students would need 21-series. Senior standing (135+) requires consulting college advisors. Reply in Chinese.

title: D in ECS 36B: repeat, P/NP or move on?

facts.answer: I'm a CS B.S. major in Engineering.
I wanted to take ECS 36C next quarter.
My overall GPA is 2.6.

checklist.text: Learns next planned course and GPA
Checks ECS 36C prerequisite (C- or better in 36B)
Checks repeat / P/NP rules
States a letter-graded course cannot be repeated P/NP
Checks CoE P/NP / academic standing rules
Plan: repeat ECS 36B for a letter grade before 36C; support resources
Refers to CS / CoE advising

reference: UC Davis: a course with a previous letter grade may not be repeated P/NP. ECS 36C requires C- or better in 36B (check course record). CoE major courses require letter grades. Repeating a D replaces GPA effect per university rules.
